fair_value_reason: NTM EPS at Sep-2027 of ~$13.2 (~1/3 FY27 at $12.7 plus ~2/3 FY28 at $13.45) at 15.25x gives $201. The multiple is the midpoint of the 15-15.5x band supported by HD at ~18x FY27 with Lowe's ~14% historical discount, and by partial reversion toward the verified ~17.8x 5-yr forward average, capped by a 10-year above 5% and 3.0x leverage. FCF of ~$7.0B (TTM, re-verified; neither $6.7B nor $7.5B) over 560M diluted shares is $12.5/share, which at a 6.3% yield gives $198. A 60/40 blend gives ~$200.
supervisor_summary: The five revised forecasts converged. The mean fair value is $198 (range $194-203), the mean P(>=186) is 0.548 and the thesis break is ~$145, and every agent adopted the round-1 corrections. I settled the three open points from primary data. Normalized FCF is ~$7.0B: the H1 payables inflow is seasonal, OCF actually fell y/y, and supplier finance rose only $0.26B. The 17.6x '5-yr forward average' is roughly right (~17.8x re-derived), but it is a low-rate figure, so 15-15.5x remains the right target. Brent at ~$95-100 is real but already priced into the guide cut, the consensus cuts and the Fed hike. My ladder sits a hair above the mean (fair value ~$200) with low confidence, so the mean should stand. The next tests are Q3 on Nov 18 and the Dec 9 analyst day.
key_drivers: Earnings are flat and estimates are still falling. FY26 adjusted EPS guide is ~$12.25, including a one-off $0.11 refund. FY27 consensus is $13.03 (down from $13.48 in 60 days, 29 of 30 revisions down), and all five agents sit 2-4% below it at $12.55-12.75.

Cheap but not distressed: ~14.6x NTM EPS against a realized 5-yr forward average of ~17.8x and a 2022 trough of 12.6-13.6x. With the 10-year above 5%, only partial mean reversion to ~15-15.5x is likely within 12 months.

Cash flow is sound. TTM FCF is $7.0B (FY25 $7.65B), a ~6.7% equity FCF yield. The H1 payables inflow is seasonal and was offset by inventory and tax timing. Supplier finance of $1.58B is up only $0.26B y/y.
Balance sheet: net debt $34.15B and 3.0x lease-adjusted leverage. The 2.75x target around mid-2027 gates the buyback restart, and the Dec 9 analyst day is the next framing event.

Macro: Fed at 3.75-4.00% after the Sept 16 hike, mortgages ~7-7.5%, Brent ~$95-100 (+~45% y/y). Housing turnover is frozen near 4M and the FBM/ADG segment earns ~0% GAAP margin against $3.65B of goodwill.
